value.title: Play Ball! Kirari starts the game ☆ Season-opening ceremony!
value.synopsis: Kirari learns how to play baseball.

value.title: Hello Welcome to Kirarin Cafe
value.synopsis: Kirari's dad opens up a new cafe using Kirari's name. While everyone enjoys Kirari's dad's entries, Roccomari, a famous French food critic, gives a low grade. Kirari's dad looks for the best ingredients and perfects the ultimate taste for Roccomari.

value.title: Myuu Naa in Love!? Kirari Duels!!
value.synopsis: Na-san saves Myu-san from a group of bullies. Myu-san falls in love with Na-san and tries to convince him to be with her. However, Na-san refuses, already being loyal to Kirari. Kirari thinks of a great idea, a relay course between Myu-san and Kirari.

value.title: Unbelievable! Mushroom in Manga Training!?
value.synopsis: Kirari enjoys manga by Himiko Saotome. Seeing that Fubuki published her own manga, Kirari decides to do it too by visiting Himiko Saotome. However, Himiko Saotome is very tired, rushing to complete her manga just in time for the SHIPS concert. She needs every help she can to bring her next manga to completion.

value.title: Kiss! Hiroto and Izumi 'Declaration of Lover!?
value.synopsis: Izumi, recently hired by Higashiyama, suddenly kisses Hiroto in front of a big crowd during a relay competition. Kirari is heartbroken, thinking that Izumi and Hiroto have both committed love. To make matters worse, the media about this kissing event spreads very quickly.

value.title: Yoka! A Tearful Scoop at a Triangle Battle!?
value.synopsis: Izumi and Kirari compete as pastry chefs. Like previous rivals, Izumi finds every method to cheat by intentionally hurting Kirari. Meanwhile, tabloid reporters reporters are capturing illegal photos and spreading reports about the triangle battle between Hiroto, Kirari, and Izumi.

value.title: Clouds of Steam! Mission : Guard Hiroto!!
value.synopsis: Izumi and Hiroto now star in a new drama. Kirari spies on them, ensuring that Izumi does not go overboard with Hiroto. After failing to find a place to live, Kirari suddenly meets an old lady, who lets her stay for the night and invites her to a kimono competition. Izumi, rivaling Kirari, will enter the competition as well.

value.title: Wow!? A Mir･a･cle of a Girl in Summer Kimono!
value.synopsis: The kimono competition finally begins. Izumi steals a marker and doodles all over Kirari's kimono, ruining her entry. Although Kirari was able to make a new submission, both Izumi and Kirari's entry becomes overshadowed by Fubuki's entry. Izumi becomes infuriated and chases Fubuki only to reveal her true identity: Hyoutaro, a guy who Hiroto vowed to form an idol unit with until he moved away.

value.title: To Outer Space! Kirari☆ in the End of the Earth
value.synopsis: The world is coming to an end and only Kirari can save the world with her voice. Erina joins in unexpectedly.

value.title: Revolution!! A Flower Clock of a Girl and Kirari
value.synopsis: While Kirari discusses a new drama she has been cast in with her family, a boy comes into Kirarin Cafe and passes out. Once he wakes up, he tells Kirari about how his younger sister, a musician with respiratory disease, is in the hospital and wants Kirari to visit her.

value.title: Hikaru ☆ A Cocky Candidate for Idol!
value.synopsis: Kirari meets a new idol girl named Hikaru, but maybe they got off on the wrong foot.

value.title: Strain! Kirari and Hikaru's First Performance!!
value.synopsis: Hikaru will be performing on stage, but has a nervous case of stage fright. Kirari has to help Hikaru in time for the show.

value.title: Smash! A Victory Pair·Huu?
value.synopsis: A familiar cat comes back from Na-san's graduation, and holds a severe grudge against him.

value.title: Kira☆Pika♪ in a Pinch!? They are NS!!
value.synopsis: Hikaru experiences what Kirari's stardom life is like.

value.title: Shoot! I Wish Fan Letters Would Touch Her Heart!!
value.synopsis: A childhood friendship between Hikaru and a boy begins to crumble as both put each other aside to pursue their individual dreams.

value.title: Audition! Our Rival is SUPERNOVA!!
value.synopsis: Kira☆Pika is doing an audition for a movie, and their rival is SUPERNOVA, a new idol group.

value.title: Horror! Specter-Buster is at Work!
value.synopsis: Kirari and Hikaru star as superheroes in a new horror movie. Meanwhile, Muranishi's manager thinks he's been cursed from trying to renovate the office. Kirari and Hikaru decide to intervene.

value.title: Hi!! Comedy Competition·Why!?
value.synopsis: A comedy competition is coming up for idols, so Arashi shows up and puts Kirari and Hikaru through harsh training. But will SUPERNOVA steal the show?

value.title: Kirarin☆Cologne! I Might be Happy
value.synopsis: Kirari and hikaru want to create their own perfume, but can't come up with any good ideas.

value.title: Summer! Swimsuit! All-star Cast
value.synopsis: The Muranishi crew goes to Cresent Island for a day at the beach, and the Higashiyama crew shows up as the same time. While the idols unwind and Kumoi and Higashiyama's director fight over Muranishi director's attention, an island "secret" appears...

value.title: Check! Kirari and Hikaru Coordinate Clothes?
value.synopsis: Kirari and Hikaru are going to be starting their new clothes line called DOUBLE CRESENT. However, they can't seem to come up with any good fashion ideas.

value.title: Quaver! Lost DOUBLE CRESCENT!?
value.synopsis: Kirari and Hikaru work together in a department store to help work on their designing for their clothes line. However, every match they come up with doesn't work out with the customers. How will Kirari and Hikaru be able to learn from their mistakes, and will they be able to do it in time?

value.title: Musical♪ Outburst! Lose Weight!!
value.synopsis: Kirari and Hikaru are going to be in a musical, but Kirari loses her focus from only thinking of food.

value.title: Twinkle! Hikaru☆ on Stage!
value.synopsis: SUPERNOVA is desperately trying to ruin the sisterly relationship between Kirari and Hikaru as an important concert is only days away.

value.title: Dark Entrapment that Tears Kira☆Pika Apart!?
value.synopsis: After many days of perseverance, SUPERNOVA finally tears Kira☆Pika apart.

value.title: Forever♪ Kira☆Pika Last Concert♪♪
value.synopsis: With an emotionally distressed Hikaru on the sidelines, Kirari must figure out how to end Kira☆Pika's stardom with a bang.

value.title: SHIPS vs GEPS
value.synopsis: Tina comes to Japan with the duo GEPS, who teach Hiroto the true meaning of dance.

value.title: SHIPS Disbands!? Good-bye Hiroto...
value.synopsis: With the fall of SHIPS, Hiroto is leaving to New York to study. Kirari becomes lonely and she doesn't know what to do.

value.title: Uh-huh!? Mushroom Ambassador and HAPPY MAITAKE!!
value.synopsis: Kirari's mushroom theme is all the rage in Japan.

value.title: SOS! Nā-san Robot is Magnum-force!!
value.synopsis: Na-san has a robotic toy made just like him. But what will happen when a glitch in the robots takes control of the situation?

value.title: SEIJI☆Secretly Pursues Solo Work!!
value.synopsis: Hiroto is in New York while Seiji remains in Japan. Muranishi's director asks Seiji if he would like pursue a solo career, but Seiji doesn't want to sing without Hiroto. Meanwhile, Kirari helps to design male clothes and she asks Seiji to be her model.

value.title: Tsuinzu! Tonde Massuru! Nabe Tabemassuru!!
value.synopsis: SUPERNOVA, now without interference from Kira☆Pika, is trying to find a new athletic trainer, but is being turned down by all the trainers they come up with.

value.title: Confess your Heart! Erina Falls in Love!
value.synopsis: Love is in the air, and Erina has been lovestruck...with Kirari's brother! With Kirari's help, will Erina be able to impress Subaru?

value.title: Crane and Tortoise! Kirari and Seiji Get Married Suddenly!?
value.synopsis: Seiji's parents originally never wanted Seiji to be an idol. One day they draw the line by severing their consent and telling Seiji has to come home and get married. Now Seiji must introduce a girl to his parents if he's going to save his career, and that girl is...Kirari?!

value.title: Black Ambition! Blackwood Starts Up
value.synopsis: Blackwood becomes a popular idol company, and many idols "decide" to be sponsored by it.

value.title: Black Revolution! Crisis in the Muranishi Company
value.synopsis: Blackwood is having a great start, but there is trouble ahead...

value.title: Burakku Muun!? NAZO no Shōjo Debut!!
value.synopsis: The director of Blackwood threatens Kirari to join his company or else he will ruin the careers of her and everyone around her.

value.title: Ocha Kumi Kirari Ha Mi Ta! Kuroki Himitsu!!
value.synopsis: Kirari has had enough of Blackwood's manager, and stands up to him. In response, he pulls the company's sponsorship. Now Kirari must continue her idol career without credibility or sponsorship.

value.title: Kuro Fesu! Sutēji no Kirari Dai Shuugou!!
value.synopsis: Hiroto returns from New York and becomes SHIPS with Seiji again, and Kirari is accepted back into Muranishi with open arms.

value.title: First Date? Kirari's Collection
value.synopsis: Hiroto and Seiji both ask Kirari out on a date. But she's followed by two tabloid reporters and both of her dates are featured in a magazine.

value.title: SHAKIN! KIRARI × charismatic beautician
value.synopsis: Kirari meets a hairdresser with very bizarre methods. When she arranges Na-san like a moikan, Kirari decides to challenge the hairdresser. Who will win?

value.title: Aoi idol graduation
value.synopsis: Aoi says she is retiring as an idol, and receives an explosive goodbye from her idol friends.

value.title: Jump around! Kirari on Ice!!
value.synopsis: Kirari and the other idols will make a show on ice, but Kirari can't skate, and there is a special guest star with them.

value.title: Micchaku 24 Jikan Aidoru no Himitsu!!
value.synopsis: A likeable reporter will pass a day with Kirari to admire her style of life, and is about to learn that the idol life has less perks than the tabloids appeal to others.

value.title: Kirari Hime!! Bacharugemu de Daibouken Nano Resu
value.synopsis: Kirari and SHIPS will enter a video game, but a glitch runs amok endangering them all.

value.title: Hollywood! Actress Luna Visit Japan!!
value.synopsis: An actress comes to Japan from America.

value.title: That's not fair, is it? Lucas Berg Audition
value.synopsis: All the top idols are invited to do an audition.

value.title: KIRARI and HANIKAMIDETO ☆ Luna! !
value.synopsis: Luna spends the day with Kirari and her manager then later goes out with Kirari to an amusement park. Meanwhile, Kirari's mother in the Tsukishima family portrait looks very familiar, like a certain actress... Kiari realised that Luna-chan is her mom?

value.title: Start filming! Miracle meet. Naomi and Sakurako
value.synopsis: Kirari and Luna film a movie on an island.

value.title: ... Mom! Crank up the tears
value.synopsis: Luna confesses to Kirari that she is Kirari's mother.

value.title: Kirari's Farewell Concert!?
value.synopsis: Emotionally damaged from Luna's confession, Kirari holds one last concert. A series reflection takes place. This is the last episode in 2D. Episode 103 will start the series in 3D avatar figures.
